findings: The prior accumulation defect is repaired: Crossing.arm clears pre-release intersections and begins a new sampled record only after the initial bridge qualification (task/run_moving_aperture_crossing_probe.py:184-194).

The causal release gate is still unsound: release_step permanently latches on the first single physics sample with fewer than two reported rib contacts, and arming may occur much later even if two-rib support has recovered. Therefore causal_crossing_window_armed_after_support_loss can pass after a transient contact-sensor dropout rather than actual continuing loss of support. Require the arming sample itself (or a defined fresh consecutive window ending at it) to have fewer than two distinct rib contacts, and report that release window (task/run_moving_aperture_crossing_probe.py:333-347, task/run_moving_aperture_crossing_probe.py:403-405).

The probe remains honestly bounded to sampled endpoint geometry and explicitly disclaims continuous swept coverage and full qualification; native results are correctly left for post-review execution (task/run_moving_aperture_crossing_probe.py:383-384, task/run_moving_aperture_crossing_probe.py:416-419).
